description: This file defines the OrganizationRepository class with methods for creating, retrieving, and managing organization data in a database, including handling memberships, settings, and related entities.

classes.name: OrganizationRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing organization data, including creation, retrieval, and updates related to organizations and their settings.

methods.name: createWithExistingUserAsOwner
methods.description: Creates an organization and assigns an existing user as its owner, including profile creation and membership assignment.

methods.name: createWithNonExistentOwner
methods.description: Creates an organization and a new user as its owner based on email, generating username from email and establishing membership.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization (team) with specified data, including settings and metadata.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an organization by its ID.

methods.name: findBySlug
methods.description: Finds an organization by its slug.

methods.name: findBySlugIncludeOnboarding
methods.description: Finds an organization by slug including onboarding details.

methods.name: findByIdIncludeOrganizationSettings
methods.description: Finds an organization by ID including organization settings and metadata.

methods.name: findUniqueNonPlatformOrgsByMatchingAutoAcceptEmail
methods.description: Finds non-platform organizations matching a specific auto-accept email domain.

methods.name: findCurrentOrg
methods.description: Retrieves current organization details for a user, including membership and settings.

methods.name: findTeamsInOrgIamNotPartOf
methods.description: Finds teams within an organization that the user is not a member of.

methods.name: adminFindById
methods.description: Admin-level retrieval of organization details by ID, including members and settings.

methods.name: findByMemberEmail
methods.description: Finds an organization by a member’s email.

methods.name: findByMemberEmailId
methods.description: Finds an organization by a member’s email with debug logging.

methods.name: findCalVideoLogoByOrgId
methods.description: Retrieves the calVideoLogo URL for an organization by ID.

methods.name: getVerifiedOrganizationByAutoAcceptEmailDomain
methods.description: Retrieves a verified organization matching an auto-accept email domain.

methods.name: setSlug
methods.description: Updates the slug of an organization.

methods.name: updateStripeSubscriptionDetails
methods.description: Updates Stripe subscription details in organization metadata.

methods.name: checkIfPrivate
methods.description: Checks if an organization is private.

methods.name: getOrganizationAutoAcceptSettings
methods.description: Retrieves auto-accept email and verification status for an organization.

methods.name: findPlatformOrgByUserId
methods.description: Finds a platform organization associated with a user ID.
